# Tonguç Karaçay

> Personal website and blog of Tonguç Karaçay — a digital consultant based in Istanbul, Turkey, with 25+ years of experience in UI/UX design, SEO consulting, digital marketing, AI-powered growth strategies, and social media management. Serving clients in Turkey, the USA, Canada, and Germany.

## About

Tonguç Karaçay is an independent digital consultant who has worked with 100+ brands including Turkish Airlines, BMW, Jaguar, Range Rover, Galatasaray, and major Turkish media groups. His expertise spans UI/UX design, technical SEO, Google Ads, AI automation, and generative engine optimization (GEO/AEO).

The blog covers practical, experience-based guides — not theory. All content is written by Tonguç Karaçay and regularly updated to reflect current algorithm changes and industry developments.
